text:
Gio Canali named to Brazil's roster for U20 FIFA Women’s World Cup
G. E. Root
Third-year forward Gio Canali was named to the Brazilian roster for the FIFA U20 Women’s World Cup, according to an announcement by the Brazilian Federation on Aug. 19. The tournament will be hosted in Poland from Sept. 5-27.
Brazil is set to compete in Group B and will open its World Cup campaign against Tanzania on Saturday, Sept. 5. The team will then face Canada on Tuesday, Sept. 8, and conclude the group stage against England on Friday, Sept. 11. All of Brazil's group matches are scheduled at Stadion Miejski Bielsko-Biala in Bielsko-Biala. Every match of the tournament will be broadcast on the FOX family of networks.
Canali was most recently called up to Brazil's U20 team in May for friendlies against Finland, South Korea, and Portugal. She also played in a pair of friendlies against the United States back in April when both teams met in Kansas City. Since 2023, Canali has been a regular member of Brazil’s U20 roster through multiple call-ups.
This past week, Canali made her debut for the Cavaliers and contributed with a goal and an assist during a season-opening win over Northwestern. Her goal served as the game winner while she assisted on the opening goal.
